input.quote: 10.2 Vendor shall deliver all completed and in-process Deliverables for which Customer has paid or agrees to pay the applicable proportionate Fees. Vendor shall refund prepaid recurring Fees covering the period after termination, together with Fees paid for Services Customer cannot reasonably use because of Vendor's uncured breach.
input.rationale: Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) covers only access cut-off after an undefined "agreed transition period" (10.1) and Deliverable delivery/refunds (10.2). No provision anywhere obligates Vendor to provide exit or migration assistance, to return or export Customer Data in a usable format within a set period, or to delete and certify deletion. Section 16.5 expressly carves Customer Data out of the confidentiality return/destroy mechanic and defers it to "Sections 11 and 15" — Section 11 does not exist in the document and Section 15 contains no return, export, or deletion mechanics. This is a hosted-services agreement, so the absence fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export). Proposed insertion of a new 10.3 at the preferred position: up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, and certified deletion thereafter.

ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause: the Agreement currently ends Customer's access after an undefined "agreed transition period" with no obligation to return Customer Data or assist with migration. Our playbook requires up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can work with 90 days of assistance if that is easier for you.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations in Section 10.
